name: Hyper-Kamiokande Design Report
notes: Listed as a technical design report, the closest available document type: the paper's own title calls it a 'Design Report', and its source record type is 'design_report'.

summary.plain: The main planning document describing what Hyper-Kamiokande will be and why it is being built.
summary.technical: Hyper-Kamiokande Design Report: physics case (CP violation, proton decay, atmospheric/solar/supernova/astrophysical neutrinos), detector concept (large water-Cherenkov cavern at Tochibora, ~295 km from J-PARC, same 2.5 degree off-axis angle as Super-Kamiokande), and new photosensor technology.
